topic: Data setup for new physical locations
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on addressing zero metrics for newly added physical advertising locations (billboards/signage). The current issue is that the system does not automatically predict or record data for these new sites. To resolve this, someone will update the `device_session_agg_ml` file to include total traffic, rots, and vac counts for these locations.

[me] advised that it would be best practice to link (bind) virtual sessions to these physical assets now, even if a more complex method is planned later. This requires [unknown] to provide a new file with the linked sensors.
decisions: New physical locations require updated data records in `device_session_agg_ml` for traffic and session metrics.
action_items: [unknown] will prepare and send a new file containing the newly linked sensors/locations.
